name: Step Size Selection
aliases: Ray Marching with Fixed Step Count
definition: The process of determining the distance between samples (step_size) during ray-marching. It is a trade-off between rendering speed and accuracy, as smaller steps provide more accurate Riemann sum approximations of the integral but require more computation.
summary: Step Size Selection uses a fixed interval between samples to trade rendering speed for accuracy, distinguishing itself from adaptive methods by ignoring local density variations.
